title: S101: should mention how to handle mypy validation
author: spaceone
body_preview: I often need to use: `assert self.x is not None`  to silent mypy or ty.  e.g. if `self.x` is initialized with None in the constructor and later ensured to be assigned.  The `ruff rule S101` docs should mention that this is a valid use case or give examples how to mitigate it in a better way.
